1479-2841-6156-8337.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-8337.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and M'Ress trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2228-3845-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-3845-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-3845-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

147-2511-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-2511-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

443-2738-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Magus of the Bridge, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

215-2404-5475-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-2404-5475-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Forensic Researcher any number of times.

3413-5256-5929.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2103-2187-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Possessed Skaab.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Possessed Skaab from exile to the battlefield.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4875-6264-7767.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to discard a card.
4875-6264-7767.description:
Discard a card.
Cryptcaller Chariot triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters as a Villain due to Conspiracy, Prowler triggers, causing it to connive.
Repeat from step 2.
4875-6264-7767.notes: You will need to break the combo, or you will eventually lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

5704-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with power 4 or greater.
5704-7282-7340.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Leafkin Avenger.
Repeat.

339-677-997-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-1322-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-1322-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-5422-6751.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve both The Third Doctor triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4629-7121-7124.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Incredible Hulk.
4629-7121-7124.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving The Incredible Hulk firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker. Its firebending ability triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.
4629-7121-7124.notes: If desired, you can use the remaining {R} to activate Pyrohemia more times and stack combat phases.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4908-4993.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2033-3490-4068-7075.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
You control at least one Mountain.
2033-3490-4068-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3480-4871-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

3525-5251-6723.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding {U}.
Emmara triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

2034-3781-4215--124.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
2034-3781-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

1353-1718-2744-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1353-1718-2744-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1170-3200-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Urza's Bauble is in your graveyard.
1170-3200-6643.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2921-3560-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
2921-3560-5972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3197-3297-4304.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Bear" on Ayula to "Beast"
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 4.

3259-4068-4382.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one artifact.
You control a Mountain.
3259-4068-4382.description:
Declare Naomi and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Naomi triggers, creating a 2/2 Samurai creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Samurai token, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

122-1545-1734-5256.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Trostani.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player(s) to mill infinite cards.

1368-2056-3698-4036.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
1368-2056-3698-4036.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Seething Song from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Saheeli triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

413-818-2757-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control a basic land.
You control at least one additional creature.
You are the monarch.
413-818-2757-3490.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping any other creature you control, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the tapped creature, targeting Jared and putting a +1/+1 counter on Jared.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
The Servo enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1837-2145.description: Erayo counters the first spell cast, and Arcane Laboratory only lets players cast one spell a turn.

914-1099-1799-2048.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1099-1799-2048.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
